decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - External materials shall be those agreed under planning permission reference 84/39-41/P7(a), i.e. Butley Old English Light Reds unless otherwise approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing. All new joinery shall be of painted timber.
Condition : 4 - The basement shall be used only for ancillary storage or purposes incidental to the use of Nos. 39-41 Bath Road as an hotel and shall not be used as habitable rooms.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8.00 a.m.  to 6.00 p.m.  on Mondays to Friday and 9.30 a.m.  to 12.30 p.m. on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of single storey rear extension, erection of external staircase, formation of a new development within existing basement incorporating internal staircases to ground floor from basement and erection of a new boundary walls with new pillars to existing access to hotel.
